metric: FALLBACK end-to-end greedy NIAH answer-recall (reuse - fresh), paired by needle
primary_metric_infeasible_reason: enable_return_indexer_topk returns PHYSICAL kv-slot indices not logical positions; cross-arm logical needle selection-recall not computable client-only under radix reuse (arbitrary logical->physical remap). 77/144 needles exceed the row-2047 reconstruction ceiling. No new production code allowed.

exact_output_divergence.note: temp=0 greedy: fresh-vs-reuse divergent text on byte-IDENTICAL prompt (P+PARTIAL_TAIL). NOT a valid reuse signal -- see determinism_control: it is WITHIN the nondeterminism noise floor.

determinism_control.design: Same radix-OFF DSA-native server, each measured prompt (P+PARTIAL_TAIL) issued TWICE, both cached_tokens==0. Establishes the run-to-run nondeterminism noise floor at this op-point.
determinism_control.implication: DSA at this op-point (TP=8, EAGER, fp8 KV, no --enable-deterministic-inference) is HIGHLY nondeterministic: ~77% of bit-identical greedy requests produce different output. The 74.3% fresh-vs-reuse output divergence is BELOW this 77% floor, so it is explained ENTIRELY by nondeterminism, NOT by radix reuse. The -4.86pp answer-recall delta (CI [-11.81,+2.08] crossing zero) is likewise consistent with pure noise -- a fresh-vs-fresh recall delta would swing several pp from this same floor.

ds_reference.note: DS measured a DETERMINISTIC per-decode-step SELECTION-RECALL oracle (recall_at_k on logical needle positions captured inside the attention kernel), NOT end-to-end greedy text. That oracle is insensitive to decode-sampling/MoE nondeterminism, which is why DS resolved +1.57pp with a tight CI. The apples-to-apples DSA equivalent (indexer-topk logical selection-recall) is INFEASIBLE client-only (see primary_metric_infeasible_reason).

deterministic_inference_not_viable: Checked --enable-deterministic-inference as a way to zero the noise floor and isolate a clean reuse signal. NOT viable for this question: server_args._handle_deterministic_inference (server_args.py:4093-4097) REQUIRES attention_backend in {fa3, triton} for deepseek-family models (GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM is in the list) and rejects anything else with ValueError. The DSA sparse backend ('dsa' + flashmla_kv) is NOT allowed; deterministic mode would replace it with DENSE fa3/triton attention -- eliminating the query-dependent sparse top-k SELECTION that is the entire subject of the measurement. So nondeterminism cannot be removed while keeping DSA selection active, by flags alone.
verdict: INCONCLUSIVE via the fallback. The end-to-end answer-recall fallback CANNOT resolve a +-0.5pp (or even +-5pp) reuse effect on DSA at this op-point because the run-to-run NONDETERMINISM noise floor (~77% greedy-output divergence; several-pp recall swings) DWARFS the effect size. The fresh-vs-reuse output divergence (74.3%) is BELOW the fresh-vs-fresh floor (77%), and the recall delta CI crosses zero. So this experiment can NEITHER confirm DSA deviates like DS (+1.57pp) NOR confirm DSA stays within +-0.5pp. A definitive DSA-vs-DS parity verdict requires the DETERMINISTIC per-step indexer LOGICAL selection-recall oracle (the apples-to-apples analogue of what DS measured) -- which needs a new server-side debug field (raw logical indexer top-k or req_to_token export) since enable_return_indexer_topk surfaces only physical slots; the task constraints forbid new production code, and --enable-deterministic-inference disables DSA selection. NET: the +-0.5pp edge bar cannot be evaluated against the shipped DSA default with client-only tools at this op-point.
